items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: The interviewer addresses the interviewee as 'Dick' ('Dick, I'm going to go find them...'). There is no mention of a specific person named 'Dick' other than the interviewee himself.

ctx.x: Oh, this is just the accompaniment. No, but the clarinet play used to be with Keith Smith.

One of the things I thought about this record, Dick, it may sound corny, but it is an international record. It was made with an English band. This part was cut in Germany and was completed in New Orleans. Yeah.
